structured_output.summary: src/app.js: kept both encodeCursor (from #8) and the rate limiter (RATE_LIMIT, RATE_WINDOW_MS, rateLimit) from #9, and closed the braces that the conflict had merged. Integration fix: two earlier tests, "default page size is 20…" and "limit above 100…" in test/list-links.test.js, and "non-http(s) and malformed urls are rejected" in test/url-scheme.test.js, post more than 10 links from one client and so hit the new 429. I added an optional rateLimit option to createApp, defaulting to 10, and those two test files pass rateLimit: Infinity. No assertions were changed. The rate-limit tests still use the default. npm test passes (43 of 43), and the resolved files are staged.
